alignments.note: Aorist participle with its auxiliary and the particle realizing the ἐξ- preverb inside the unit (rules 9 and 106), headed on the verb word.
Rule 31: an article standing before the noun it governs is that noun's own determiner and takes the English determiner along with the supplied relativizer, discontinuously (rule 15), headed on the.

Rule 23: the ASV gives ordinances no determiner, so this article has nothing to anchor.

The ASV completes the bare dative with the supplied participle written; under rules 62 and 96 the supplied verb rides with the predicate noun, no determiner-bearing article standing to take it. Reading written as a second realization of χειρόγραφον is barred by rule 103, that token being already spent on bond.
Rule 31/53: the prepositional modifier has no verb of its own, so the supplied copula goes with the preposition, headed on the prepositional word.

review_notes: The ASV's margin ('the bond that was against us by its ordinances') shows the alternative construal; I follow the printed text, giving that was against to the article and the preposition and written in ordinances to the dative phrase.
Nothing is added here: the supplied written is licensed by the dative it completes under rules 62 and 96, and the supplied relativizer that by the article that precedes its noun under rule 31.
